runs.text: Two suns, two rows of cards. Heat your rival's sun to
and it goes supernova: you win. If yours gets there first, you lose.

labels.title: Their tableau
labels.text: The cards your rival has in play.

runs.text: Around the edges:

labels.title: Whose day
labels.text: Whose day it is, and its phase.

labels.title: Deck, reserves and wreckage
labels.text: Draw from the deck. Spent cards go to the wreckage, then two a dawn to the reserves.

labels.title: Energy
labels.text: Each dot pays for one point of cost.

dd.text: You and your rival take turns, called days. Each has a dawn, the day itself and a dusk.
Most cards you play stay in your tableau and keep working, day after day, until they are beaten down or removed.
30 to 40 cards. At most 2 of each, one of an Anomaly, and one Hero per 10 cards.
You start with 5 cards (the second player 6) and draw 1 at every dawn after your first.

runs.text: Every card says what it costs, what it is and what it does. A card in play also shows how hard it hits and how much it can take.

labels.title: Cost
labels.text: The green dots: energy to play it.

labels.title: Attack
labels.text: The heat it deals when it attacks.

labels.title: Type
labels.text: Entity, technology, relic, Hero, global or trap.

labels.title: What it does
labels.text: Keywords and when they act. Dawn: the start of your day.

labels.title: Stability
labels.text: How much it can take. At 0 it is gone.

dd.text: You get energy each day. Playing a card spends its cost.
Once a day, a card with attack can strike your rival's sun or one of their cards.
What a card in play can shrug off. It comes from its slot (1 · 2 · 3 · 2 · 1, left to right; the Hero's slot 3) plus any
Sturdy 1
of its own.
A card's health. Hits past its defence take stability off. At 0 the card goes to your wreckage.
Hover a keyword on a card, or open the card, to read it. Every keyword is in the keywords section.

runs.text: Each day runs the same way: dawn, then your moves, then dusk. Then it is your rival's day.

Your shields drop away. The orbit turns a notch. You draw 1 (not on your first day). From round 8, regional instability heats every sun, more each round. Any global card acts. Then every card in your tableau runs its
Dawn
effect, left to right.
You get energy equal to the days you have taken: 1 on your first, 2 on your second, up to 5. The industrial planet and energy cards add more.
In any order: play cards, attack with each ready card once, use your Hero once, set a trap. A card you play comes in dimmed: it can't attack or act until your next day, unless it has
Darkspeed
Press end day. Every
Dusk
effect runs, left to right, except on cards played today. Over 5 cards in hand, you discard down to 5 (more with Deep holds, on the Stellari's skill tree).
Energy you didn't spend is banked through their day. With it you can answer once, with a
Lightspeed
card, when they play a card or attack.

labels.title: Phases
labels.text: Dawn, day, dusk: lit as they pass.

runs.text: Attack their sun to win, or attack their cards to stop what they do to yours.

labels.title: Slot defence
labels.text: An empty slot shows the defence it gives.

labels.title: Defence
labels.text: Slot plus Sturdy, less any wear.

dd.text: Its attack lands as heat on the sun. Shields soak up heat first, 1 each.
The hit wears its defence first. Wear lasts: only
mends it, and it stays in the slot if the card leaves. Past its defence, the hit takes stability. At 0 the card goes to the wreckage.
A card that is attacked hits back with its own attack and any
Sting 1
. That wears the attacker the same way.
While they have a
Guard

in play, your attacks must hit a Guard. Heat aimed by a card you play, or by your Hero, goes where you choose. A Lost Overlord's blows at your sun or at one card fall on your Guard; a blow at every card still hits them all.
Destroy 2
and the like only reach cards with that much defence or less.
A new card replaces one of yours, which leaves play. You pick which.

runs.text: Every sun starts at 0 heat and goes supernova at 20. It can be cooled as low as -10.

labels.title: Facing planet
labels.text: Which planet faces you, and for how many more days.

labels.title: Shields
labels.text: Each blocks 1 heat. Gone at your dawn.

dd.text: Heats your rival's sun, unless the card says your own. Heat from a card as it is played can be aimed at one of their cards instead.
Takes heat off your sun.
Each blocks 1 heat aimed at your sun. They drop away at your dawn.
Three planets face your sun in turn, a day each. Dead: nothing. Abundant: draw 1 more. Industrial: 1 more energy.
From round 8, every sun takes heat at dawn, 1 more every few rounds. Games end.
Every card discarded or destroyed goes to the bottom of your wreckage. Each dawn its top two cards move on to your reserves.
Your reserves are shuffled back in, free. With both empty, you draw nothing.

runs.text: The type is written across the top of every card.

dd.text: Stays in your tableau. Attacks once a day if it has attack. Its dawn and dusk effects run every day.
Does its thing as it is played, then goes to your wreckage.
Stays, with no attack: a lasting effect.
Brittle
One per 10 cards in a deck. Leads from its own slot. Once a day: its ability, or an attack.
Changes the table for both players. One at a time.
Set face down in your trap slot, one at a time. Springs on the first thing that triggers it.

runs.text: Hover a keyword on a card, or open the card, to read it there.

dd.text: Start of your day.
End of your day.
End of your day, if this card didn't attack or act.
It has attacked or acted today. Ready again at your next dawn.
Use one of these on your day.
A Hero ability.
The Hero's ultimate. Charges while it leads, from its own thing; once full, unleash it on your day, free.
Heats your rival's sun.
Heat to a rival card, and 1 less to each card beside it.
Ignores defence.
Pick one of your cards: it gains attack while it stays in play.
Once a day, hit a rival card or sun.
Your sun is at half health or hotter.
Cools your sun. Played, it can chill a rival card instead: its attack down as much, until your next day.
Per 2 points your sun is below zero.
Blocks heat on your sun. Fades at dawn.
Cools your sun when shields block.
Your shields also guard your cards against heat.
Your shields don't fade.
Must be attacked first. A Lost Overlord's blows strike it first too.
Extra defence.
Extra defence for neighbours.
Hits back at attackers.
Can't be destroyed or returned to hand. A destroy deals its number as damage instead; Obelisks can't be aimed at.
Mends worn defence on your cards and slots.
Boosts neighbours' heat, cooling and shields.
Boosts neighbouring armed cards.
Nothing restores it, and removal reaches it whatever its defence.
Neighbours regain 1 stability at your dawn.
A rival card loses this much stability, whatever its defence.
Every rival card loses this much stability, whatever its defence.
One of your cards regains stability.
Your other cards regain stability.
The attack of an undimmed allied card is set to 0 for 1 day. Remove stability from another card equal to the removed attack.
Roots grow through the cracks: one of your cards that has grown splits a rival card's defence by its growth. Split defence stays split.
To play it, give up another of your cards in play: it leaves play, and this can take its slot.
Move one of your rival's cards to another of their slots. Not a Hero.
Destroys a rival card with this much defence or less.
Returns a rival card with this much defence or less to hand.
Reserves to hand.
One of your cards back to hand.
Move one of your cards to another slot. Not a Hero.
Play it as a card of its own, or fuse it onto one of your cards in play: that card gains its Fusion bonus, and nothing else of it.
Fills empty slots with Saplings.
Whenever it grows, your other cards grow 1 too.
Grows 1 each time it triggers, up to the max shown. Each point of growth is +1 attack.
Extra energy each day.
Spends all your energy.
Extra energy today.
Can attack or act the day it comes into play.
Costs this much energy.
Extra cards each dawn.
Moves the planets round.
Each dawn, gains your orbit's bonus. Dead planet: Shields 1. Abundant: Draw 1. Industrial: Heat 1.
Play it in any phase of your day, or on your rival's day in reply to a card they play or an attack, paid with banked energy. One in reply per rival day.
Set face down on your day. It springs on the first trigger it meets.
Affects both players.
Every game earns experience. Each level: ✦50 and ⟁10.
Buys boosters: ✦100 for 5 cards.
Crafts the cards you want. Breaking one down returns half.
Olivine → Cobalt → Iridium → Lonsdaleite → Neutronium → Strange Matter. Three stages each.
Matches players at most one tier apart. Beat higher ranks for more.
You start with every starter card. Boosters and crafting add the rest.
